s.note: Denethor eating at his table while Pippin sings
s.how: Rub 8 chicken drumsticks with butter, thyme and salt and roast at 200C for 40 minutes. Lay on a long board with 250g cherry tomatoes, red grapes and torn crusty bread. Eat slowly.

s.note: the taste of strawberries Sam reminds Frodo of
s.how: Halve 500g ripe strawberries and toss with 2 tbsp sugar and a squeeze of lemon. Rest 20 minutes. Whip 300ml cream with vanilla and serve together. Do you remember the taste of strawberries?

m.note: the coronation of the King in Minas Tirith
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg sirloin at 200C to 52C and rest. Roast 1kg potatoes. Toss 3 carrots and 3 parsnips with honey and roast for 35 minutes. Reduce 200ml red wine with the pan juices for gravy.

w.note: Sam and Rosie's wedding back in the Shire
w.how: Beat 175g butter and 175g brown sugar, add 3 eggs, then fold in 225g self-raising flour, 300g mixed dried fruit and 50g almonds. Bake at 160C for 90 minutes. Split, fill with apricot jam and cover in 300g white icing with small flowers.

d.note: back at the pub, four hobbits, quiet pints
d.how: Leave four 500ml bottles of English ale out of the fridge for an hour. Pour into pint glasses and raise a toast to absent friends.
